newsitem.title: USA: Bethlehem Steel to close structural mill.
newsitem.headline: Bethlehem Steel to close structural mill.

text.p: Bethlehem Steel Corp. said Thursday it will close a structural steel products mill in the first quarter, affecting 900 workers, after failing to find a buyer for the operation.
The company said it was continuing to negotiate with qualified buyers to sell other assets, including its BethForge, CENTEC and BethShip's Sparrows Point Yard, which it announced on Oct. 30.
Shipments from inventory at the Bethlehem, Pa.-based mill may continue for a period of time, the company said.
As previously announced, the company said it will provide outplacement assistance to employees affected by the closing.
Bethlehem Steel said it has notified the United Steelworkers of America of its plan to close the Bethlehem Structural Products structural mill, as required under a labour agreement.
Bethlehem Steel's stock was unchanged at $9 on the New York Stock Exchange at mid-afternoon.
